disclaimer.title: Moraki is a notebook, not a medical device
disclaimer.notMedical: It records what you type and adds it up. It is not a medical device, and it is not a substitute for your pediatrician, midwife or nurse.
disclaimer.noInterpretation: It never tells you what a number means. There are no warnings, no ranges and no colours on a figure, because reading those numbers is your clinician’s job, not an app’s.
disclaimer.askSomeone: Take the figures to your next appointment, or read them out on the phone. The call script is made for that.
disclaimer.urgent: If you are worried about your baby now, contact your doctor or your local emergency number. Do not wait for an appointment.

what.title: What it does
what.records: Feeds, diapers, sleep, pumping, milk stock, weight, temperatures, notes, medication and appointments, as you log them.
what.shares: Everyone in your household sees the same entries, usually within seconds of being logged.
what.offline: It works with no signal. Entries are kept on the phone and sent when there is one.

legal.title: Privacy and help
legal.contact: Questions, or a request about your data: {{email}}

consent.title: Health data
consent.what: Moraki records what you log about your baby: feeds, diapers, sleep, pumping, weight, temperatures, notes, medication and appointments. That is health data, so we ask before your entries leave this phone.
consent.where: Your entries are stored on this phone, encrypted. Once you sign in and agree, they also sync to servers in the EU, so the people in your household see them. Until you agree, your entries stay on this phone and are not shared. You still see what others in the household share.
consent.who: Only people in your household see it. The baby’s details you enter when you set up a household, like name, birth time and weight, are shared with the household as soon as you set it up, even before you agree. Nothing is ever sold, used for advertising or used to train anything.
consent.rights: You can export your data at any time in Settings → Data export → Export my data. You can leave the household or delete your account in Settings → Leave or delete. The household’s owner can delete the whole household there too.
consent.withdrawal: If you withdraw, your new entries stay on this phone and stop syncing. What you already shared stays with the household, as part of the baby’s record, until the household is deleted. Deleting your account takes it with it only if nobody else is in the household.
consent.granted: You agreed to this on this account.
consent.withdrawHint: New entries stay on this phone and stop syncing. What you already shared stays with the household.
